name: iPhone 17 Pro Max
description: Apple flagship. Large Super Retina display, A19 Pro chip, titanium frame, triple-camera system. All-day battery. Built for pro photo, video, and everyday use.

name: Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra
description: Samsung flagship. Bright AMOLED display, S Pen, titanium build, 200 MP camera. Long battery life and desktop-class multitasking on Android.

name: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold
description: Foldable phone that opens into a tablet. Inner AMOLED canvas for split-screen apps, cover screen for one-hand use. Slim hinge, pocketable when closed.

name: Samsung Galaxy Tab S10
description: Premium Android tablet. Slim aluminum body, high-refresh AMOLED, DeX desktop mode. Optional keyboard and S Pen for work and media.

name: MacBook Pro 16"
description: 16-inch Liquid Retina XDR laptop. Apple silicon, studio-grade speakers, all-day battery. Built for code, video, and heavy creative work.

name: iPad Pro
description: Ultra-thin tablet with OLED display and Apple silicon. Apple Pencil and Magic Keyboard ready. One device for sketch, edit, and stream.

name: AirPods Pro
description: In-ear wireless earbuds with active noise cancellation, Adaptive Audio, and MagSafe charging case. Sweat resistant. One-tap pair with Apple devices.

name: Google Pixel 10 Pro
description: Google flagship. Tensor chip, clean Android, pro camera bar, on-device AI editing. Seven years of OS updates. Simple, fast, camera-first phone.

name: Sony Mirrorless Camera
description: Compact full-frame style mirrorless body with kit lens. Fast autofocus, 4K video, flip screen. Travel-ready stills and video kit.

name: Portable Bluetooth Speaker
description: Compact wireless speaker. Deep bass, IP-rated shell, 12-hour battery, USB-C charge. Pair two for stereo. Desk, kitchen, or travel.
